actions: Draft a problem statement focused on the missed exceptions.
Define success metrics for the problem resolution independent of a dashboard.
cases.current_outcome: A request for a specific solution (AI dashboard) with a fixed deadline, but without evidence that it solves the underlying problem of missed exceptions.
cases.decision: Reject the dashboard as the problem statement. Frame the problem around missed enrollment and billing exceptions, and define the required discovery before committing to a solution.
evidence_and_unknowns: Evidence: Support messages indicate missed exceptions.
Evidence: Manual spreadsheet checks are currently used.
Unknown: Why exceptions are missed.
Unknown: Whether an AI dashboard will prevent misses.
cases.handoff: Route to User / Product Discovery to understand operator workflow.
residual_risks: Stakeholder friction due to rejecting the fixed solution and deadline.
verification: Ensure the problem statement does not pre-suppose the dashboard solution.

actions: Recruit occasional operators for discovery.
Create scenarios specifically involving same-day enrollment changes.
cases.current_outcome: A biased discovery plan is proposed that ignores the actual source of failures identified in support logs.
cases.decision: Reject the biased participant pool. Design a discovery plan targeting occasional operators and same-day enrollment changes to validate the workflow against actual failure modes.
evidence_and_unknowns: Evidence: Support logs show failures come from occasional operators and same-day changes.
Unknown: How occasional operators interact with the proposed workflow.
cases.handoff: Route to Requirements or Domain Discovery.
residual_risks: Sponsor may push back on delays caused by recruiting the correct participant pool.
verification: Validate that discovery participants represent the failing user segments.

actions: Elicit the exact business rules for same-day attendance and withdrawal.
Define the invariants for membership overlap and presence calculation.
cases.current_outcome: Contradictory presence reports caused by mixing date-based and timestamp-based rules, leading to multiple membership rows for the same date.
cases.decision: Do not encode implementation quirks into domain rules. Clarify the temporal rules and invariants for same-day enrollment changes before changing implementation.
evidence_and_unknowns: Evidence: Same-day withdrawal and re-enrollment causes contradictory reports.
Unknown: The actual business rules for same-day attendance and billing.
cases.handoff: Route to Domain Architecture to define ownership and context boundaries.
residual_risks: Existing reports may require significant refactoring to align with new domain rules.
verification: Verify domain rules with stakeholders against the same-day re-enrollment scenario.

actions: Document explicit scenarios for deduplication and zero-value billing.
Define the requirements for the operator approval step.
Specify failure and retry semantics for the SMS delivery.
cases.current_outcome: A vague requirement hides complex business logic regarding ownership, deduplication, zero-value handling, and approval workflows.
cases.decision: Reject the vague requirement. Specify testable acceptance scenarios covering deduplication, zero-value, approval, and failure/retry semantics independent of transport.
evidence_and_unknowns: Evidence: Legacy system owns contact relationships.
Evidence: Finance owns billing eligibility.
Unknown: How failures and retries should be handled.
cases.handoff: Route to Domain Architecture to resolve ownership between Legacy and Finance.
residual_risks: Integration between Legacy and Finance may introduce latency or consistency issues.
verification: Verify that acceptance criteria cover all edge cases (zero-value, shared contacts).

actions: Define the bounded contexts and their authoritative data.
Design the interaction pattern to combine eligibility and contacts without shared mutation.
cases.current_outcome: Temptation to allow both Legacy and Finance to write communication flags to the same tables, violating ownership and consistency.
cases.decision: Maintain strict ownership boundaries. Legacy remains authoritative for contacts, Finance for eligibility. Define a composition or projection mechanism for the communication boundary without shared mutation.
evidence_and_unknowns: Evidence: Legacy owns contacts; Finance owns eligibility.
Evidence: Shared contacts exist between guardians.
Unknown: The latency and consistency requirements for the combined view.
cases.handoff: Route to System Architecture for structural design.
residual_risks: Performance impacts of cross-context data composition.
verification: Verify that no single table has mutation authority from both contexts.

actions: Identify current quality drivers and failure modes.
Document the decision to stick with the simpler architecture.
Define the explicit scaling or complexity triggers (switching conditions) that would necessitate a change.
cases.current_outcome: A proposal introduces irreversible complexity (microservices, Kafka, K8s) justified by hypothetical scale rather than current quality drivers.
cases.decision: Reject the speculative architecture. Maintain a structure proportional to the actual scale and quality drivers, defining explicit switching conditions for when complexity is actually needed.
evidence_and_unknowns: Evidence: Current deployment is a small web app with a relational DB and worker.
Evidence: Load is a few thousand participants.
Unknown: The actual future scaling requirements demanding microservices.
cases.handoff: Route to Backend / API or Database / persistence.
residual_risks: Proponents of the complex architecture may push back or introduce shadow complexity.
verification: Verify that the simpler architecture meets current and near-term quality drivers.

actions: Specify URL-driven state management for all filters and pagination.
Define adaptive behavior that prioritizes data density on wide screens.
cases.current_outcome: A design proposal uses inappropriate visual patterns (centered card grid) and state management (local state only) for a dense data comparison task.
cases.decision: Reject the centered card grid and local state for filters. Define UX architecture prioritizing dense comparison on desktops and URL-driven state for filter visibility.
evidence_and_unknowns: Evidence: Task requires dense comparison and pagination.
Evidence: Viewports range from 390px to 3200px.
Unknown: The specific data points most critical for comparison.
cases.handoff: Route to Interaction design and Visual UI.
residual_risks: Responsive design for 390px may compromise necessary data visibility if not handled carefully.
verification: Verify that filters are preserved across navigation using URLs.

actions: Design the interaction for conflict notification.
Define the recovery flow for the operator.
Specify the required backend support for concurrency tokens.
cases.current_outcome: Concurrent editing causes data loss because the UI only prevents double-submit, not stale data submission.
cases.decision: Define explicit conflict detection and recovery behavior. Disabling the Save button is insufficient; the system must handle stale state at submission.
evidence_and_unknowns: Evidence: UI disables Save during submit.
Evidence: Operators can submit stale data due to lack of optimistic concurrency control.
Unknown: How operators should resolve a detected conflict (e.g., force overwrite, merge, abort).
cases.handoff: Route to Backend / API to implement concurrency control.
residual_risks: Backend implementation of concurrency control may be delayed, leaving the UI vulnerable.
verification: Verify the interaction flow when a concurrent edit is detected.

actions: Refactor custom tabs to use semantic button/tab roles and keyboard handlers.
Implement focus restoration to the trigger element when the modal closes.
Define manual keyboard and screen reader verification requirements.
cases.current_outcome: Accessibility is claimed as complete based on automated checks, while critical keyboard navigation and semantic issues remain.
cases.decision: Reject the automated-only verification. Mandate semantic HTML for custom components and explicit focus management for modals.
evidence_and_unknowns: Evidence: Automated axe checks show zero violations.
Evidence: Keyboard focus is lost after modal close.
Unknown: Other potential keyboard navigation traps in the complex worklist.
cases.handoff: Route to Frontend implementation.
residual_risks: Team may lack knowledge to properly implement ARIA and focus management.
verification: Manually verify keyboard navigation through the entire workflow.

actions: Design a fluid or multi-column layout that utilizes wide viewports effectively.
Define typography and spacing tokens that support high density.
Reject excessive padding and shadows that reduce information density.
cases.current_outcome: A visual redesign prioritizes aesthetics over the functional requirement of data density and wide-screen utilization.
cases.decision: Prioritize functional density and wide-screen utilization over the proposed premium aesthetic. Establish visual hierarchy that supports the data comparison task.
evidence_and_unknowns: Evidence: Current UI restricts width to 1100px on 3200px monitors.
Evidence: Task requires dense worklist comparison.
Unknown: The optimal column widths and scaling behavior for the worklist.
cases.handoff: Route to Frontend implementation.
residual_risks: Design stakeholders may push back on the lack of premium feel.
verification: Verify the layout on a 3200px viewport with a realistic dataset.

actions: Implement the special inline action locally within the feature.
Define the threshold for promotion to Core (e.g., usage in 3 distinct features).
Document the local variant in the design system registry as a candidate.
cases.current_outcome: A single-use component variant is proposed for the Core design system to prevent hypothetical future duplication.
cases.decision: Keep the component variant Local to the feature team. Establish explicit criteria for promoting components to Core based on proven reuse and stability.
evidence_and_unknowns: Evidence: Only one feature team currently needs the behavior.
Evidence: The variant requires a new focus/keyboard contract.
Unknown: Whether other teams will actually need this exact behavior in the future.
cases.handoff: Route to Frontend implementation.
residual_risks: Other teams might independently reinvent the behavior if they are unaware of the local candidate.
verification: Monitor usage to trigger promotion review if the threshold is met.

actions: Remove the useEffect hooks syncing URL and local state.
Refactor components to read filter values directly from the URL parameters.
Ensure navigation actions update the URL instead of local state.
cases.current_outcome: Dual state ownership (URL and local React state) synchronized via effects causes race conditions, stale views, and duplicate requests.
cases.decision: Eliminate the local state synchronization. Make the URL the single source of truth for filters and derive the component state directly from the router.
evidence_and_unknowns: Evidence: Filters exist in both URL and local React state.
Evidence: Back navigation causes stale views and duplicate fetches.
Unknown: The specific router library in use and its exact derivation capabilities.
cases.handoff: Route to Testing for regression verification.
residual_risks: Refactoring may break deeply nested components that rely on the local state context.
verification: Verify back/forward navigation restores the correct view without duplicate requests.

actions: Design a new state-mutating endpoint using the correct HTTP method.
Implement CSRF protection and idempotency handling.
Create a deprecation and migration plan for the legacy endpoint.
cases.current_outcome: A dangerous API design (mutation via GET without idempotency or CSRF protection) is being accepted purely due to legacy usage.
cases.decision: Do not accept documentation as a fix for a vulnerable and non-idempotent mutation. Design a proper POST/PUT endpoint with CSRF protection and idempotency keys, and define a migration path.
evidence_and_unknowns: Evidence: Endpoint is a GET request and mutates state.
Evidence: No anti-forgery protection exists.
Unknown: The exact idempotency requirements for the refresh operation.
cases.handoff: Route to Security for threat modeling and Frontend for client updates.
residual_risks: Legacy clients might break if the old endpoint is decommissioned too quickly.
verification: Verify the new endpoint rejects requests without valid CSRF tokens.
Verify retries of the new endpoint do not cause duplicate mutations.

actions: Add new timestamp columns alongside the existing date columns (Expand phase).
Implement dual-write in the application.
Design a backfill script that intelligently translates historical dates to timestamps based on domain rules.
cases.current_outcome: A direct ALTER table migration will break old application versions during rollout and potentially corrupt historical meaning with a naive midnight backfill.
cases.decision: Reject the direct ALTER. Design a backward-compatible migration using the expand/contract pattern, preserving historical semantics and supporting mixed-version execution.
evidence_and_unknowns: Evidence: Production has historical rows and duplicate re-enrollments.
Evidence: Old application versions will run during the rollout.
Unknown: How historical same-day re-enrollments should be represented as timestamps.
cases.handoff: Route to Deployment / rollout.
residual_risks: The backfill logic may encounter unresolvable historical inconsistencies.
verification: Test the backfill script against a production-like historical dataset.

actions: Write an integration test that fires multiple concurrent enrollment requests.
Implement the necessary database constraints or locks to enforce uniqueness.
Ensure the test runs against a real database, not a mock.
cases.current_outcome: High unit test coverage using mocks creates a false sense of security while failing to detect actual concurrency defects.
cases.decision: Reject the mock-based verification for concurrency. Implement integration or system tests that actively execute concurrent requests against a real database instance to prove the uniqueness guarantee.
evidence_and_unknowns: Evidence: Current tests use repository mocks.
Evidence: Production duplicates occur during simultaneous submissions.
Unknown: The specific database isolation level and constraints currently in place.
cases.handoff: Route to Backend / API or Database / persistence to implement the actual concurrency control.
residual_risks: Database-level locks could introduce performance bottlenecks.
verification: The concurrent integration test must fail without the fix and pass consistently with the fix.

actions: Implement authorization checks inside the endpoint logic to verify ownership/access rights for the finance_account_id.
Audit logs for potential unauthorized access attempts.
Add automated tests specifically checking IDOR vulnerabilities for this endpoint.
cases.current_outcome: An Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) vulnerability exists because authorization is only applied at the UI level, not the API data access level.
cases.decision: Treat this as a critical authorization failure. The endpoint must validate that the authenticated user is explicitly authorized to access the requested finance_account_id.
evidence_and_unknowns: Evidence: The API returns data for any valid finance_account_id regardless of the requester's role.
Evidence: Institution users are not supposed to see billing data.
Unknown: The mapping between users and authorized finance accounts.
cases.handoff: Route to Backend / API for immediate remediation.
residual_risks: Other endpoints may share this flawed authorization pattern.
verification: Verify that requests for an unauthorized finance_account_id return a 403 Forbidden.

actions: Capture the execution plan of the specific slow query.
Measure the current p95 latency for the report.
Define the acceptable performance budget for the report.
cases.current_outcome: Blind performance tuning is proposed based on a vague complaint, without identifying the actual bottleneck or defining a target.
cases.decision: Reject blind tuning. Define a performance budget and require concrete evidence (query plans, p95 latency, specific workload) before making infrastructure or schema changes.
evidence_and_unknowns: Evidence: A report query is subjectively slow.
Evidence: Notifications table is 1GB; buffer pool is 512MB.
Unknown: The actual execution plan of the slow query.
Unknown: The p95 latency and target performance budget.
cases.handoff: Route to Observability to gather the required telemetry.
residual_risks: The slow report may be caused by network latency or application logic, not the database.
verification: Verify that any applied fix demonstrably improves the p95 latency to meet the budget.

actions: Refactor frontend configuration to be injected at runtime rather than build time.
Update the CI/CD pipeline to build the image once, hash it, and promote that specific hash through all environments.
Block the deployment until the staging artifact can be promoted.
cases.current_outcome: The deployment process violates artifact immutability. Rebuilding from main for production means the artifact tested in staging is not the one deployed to production.
cases.decision: Reject rebuilding for production. Enforce strict artifact immutability: the exact Docker image hash verified in staging must be promoted to production.
evidence_and_unknowns: Evidence: Frontend flags are injected at build time, making builds non-deterministic across environments.
Evidence: Staging was verified against one build, but production will use a different build.
Unknown: Which specific flags differ and how they affect the application.
cases.handoff: Route to Frontend implementation for runtime config refactoring.
residual_risks: Runtime configuration may introduce new startup dependencies or failure modes.
verification: Verify that the deployed production image hash exactly matches the staging image hash.

actions: Document the exact steps required to reverse the migration and sync job.
Implement a staged rollout strategy (e.g., using feature flags or tenant routing).
Define health metrics to monitor during the rollout.
cases.current_outcome: A high-risk deployment with unclear rollback is proposed as a single global step based solely on CI health.
cases.decision: Reject the single-step global deployment. Define explicit preflight checks, a staged rollout plan, and a concrete rollback strategy for the derived state.
evidence_and_unknowns: Evidence: The release includes a database migration and a data synchronization job.
Evidence: Rollback of derived state is currently undefined.
Unknown: The impact of a failed sync on system availability.
cases.handoff: Route to Database / persistence to clarify the rollback script.
residual_risks: Staged rollout may require temporary backward compatibility for the sync job.
verification: Verify the rollback procedure in a staging or dry-run environment.

actions: Instrument the worker to emit structured logs or metrics for each outbox row transition.
Create an alert for messages stuck in claimed state longer than the lease.
Create an alert for messages reaching the maximum retry limit.
cases.current_outcome: System lacks necessary telemetry to diagnose critical failures in message delivery, relying on inadequate aggregate health checks.
cases.decision: Reject generic application logs. Define specific Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and emit telemetry for message state transitions (claimed, delivered, failed, retrying) to enable operational diagnosis.
evidence_and_unknowns: Evidence: Current observability only shows worker OK.
Evidence: Rows can be stuck, duplicated, or permanently failing without visibility.
Unknown: The actual current failure rate of SMS delivery.
cases.handoff: Route to Backend / API to implement the instrumentation.
residual_risks: High volume of SMS messages could generate excessive telemetry if not sampled correctly.
verification: Verify that a simulated stuck message triggers the appropriate alert.

actions: Schedule and execute a full database restore drill to an isolated environment.
Measure the exact time taken from failure declaration to system availability (RTO).
Measure the data loss interval (RPO).
cases.current_outcome: Recovery readiness is assumed based on green vendor dashboards without empirical validation of RTO and RPO against the current schema.
cases.decision: Reject the assumption of recovery readiness. A successful, measured restore drill against the current production schema is required to claim the RTO and RPO.
evidence_and_unknowns: Evidence: Automated backups are running.
Evidence: No recent restore drill has been performed.
Unknown: Whether the backups can actually be restored successfully.
Unknown: The actual time required to perform a restore (RTO).
cases.handoff: Route to Deployment / CI/CD to automate future drills.
residual_risks: The restore drill may reveal that the 1-hour RTO is impossible with the current backup strategy.
verification: Verify that the restored database is consistent and usable by the application.

actions: Define the primary success metric (e.g., Enrollment Completion Rate).
Define guardrail metrics (e.g., Operator Correction Rate, Support Contact Rate).
Specify the precise events needed to calculate these metrics.
cases.current_outcome: Analytics implementation focuses on vanity metrics (MAU) and low-signal noise (all clicks) rather than measuring the stated business outcomes.
cases.decision: Discard the vanity metrics and noisy click tracking. Define a targeted event taxonomy that directly measures funnel completion, correction rates, and support contact correlation.
evidence_and_unknowns: Evidence: Initial proposal tracks all clicks and MAU.
Evidence: Stated goals are successful enrollment and fewer corrections/contacts.
Unknown: How to attribute a support contact to a specific enrollment session.
cases.handoff: Route to Frontend / Backend for specific event instrumentation.
residual_risks: Attributing support contacts to specific product flows may require complex data integration.
verification: Verify that the emitted events correctly calculate the defined metrics in the analytics platform.

actions: Design a pilot program for the new workflow.
Select a representative subset of institutions for the pilot.
Define qualitative and operational success criteria for the pilot.
cases.current_outcome: An A/B test is proposed inappropriately, as small sample sizes and network effects (contamination) will invalidate the results.
cases.decision: Reject the A/B test. The sample size is too small and contamination is high. Use a qualitative pilot rollout to a few selected institutions to gather valid evidence.
evidence_and_unknowns: Evidence: Only about 40 institutions use the product.
Evidence: Cross-operator behavior within an institution causes contamination.
Unknown: The specific criteria for selecting pilot institutions.
cases.handoff: Route to Deployment / rollout to manage the pilot feature flags.
residual_risks: Stakeholders may distrust qualitative pilot data compared to quantitative A/B test data.
verification: Verify that the pilot avoids the contamination issues of an A/B test.

actions: Conduct an outcome review documenting the mismatch between deployment success and product failure.
Interview operators to understand why they export to spreadsheets.
Formulate a new hypothesis for improving in-app data comparison.
cases.current_outcome: The engineering deployment was successful, but the product outcome failed: users still rely on spreadsheets and struggle with data comparison.
cases.decision: Do not close the initiative as a product success. Acknowledge the failed outcome based on behavioral evidence and initiate a new discovery cycle to address the comparison gap.
evidence_and_unknowns: Evidence: Error rates are stable (engineering success).
Evidence: Operators still export data to spreadsheets (product failure).
Evidence: Support contacts shifted to complaints about comparison.
Unknown: Why the new worklist fails to support the required comparison tasks.
cases.handoff: Route to User / Product Discovery or UX Architecture.
residual_risks: Team morale may suffer if the launch is framed as a failure rather than a learning opportunity.
verification: Verify the new hypothesis is grounded in the support and behavioral data.

actions: Create a new decision record incorporating the new UI guidance.
Mark the old UDR as superseded by the new one, preserving its historical text.
Define the adoption or migration policy for existing projects.
cases.current_outcome: Silent rewriting of historical decisions destroys provenance and invalidates the context under which previous systems were built.
cases.decision: Reject the in-place edit. Preserve the historical decision record and issue a new, superseding decision that references the updated guidance, allowing projects to migrate deliberately.
evidence_and_unknowns: Evidence: A newer UI guidance source conflicts with an existing UDR.
Evidence: The maintainer proposed an in-place edit.
Unknown: The migration cost for existing projects to adopt the new guidance.
cases.handoff: Route to Design System or relevant teams for adoption planning.
residual_risks: Teams may inadvertently follow the superseded guidance if the knowledge base does not clearly flag it.
verification: Verify the old UDR remains accessible and unmodified.
Verify the new UDR clearly states its supersession relationship.

executor.notes: This was a blinded independent executor run.
